title: Professor Goodwin
html_source: Goodwin is an elderly pianist who often performed with Molly. He appears on Bloom’s list of suspected Molly suitors. However, it is unlikely that Molly had a sexual interest in the elderly alcoholic.

anchor.prefix:
Bloom, you are my darling. 
You are my lookingglass from night to morning. 
I'd rather have you without a farthing 
Than Katey Keogh with her ass and garden. 

1939#48

 Poor old
anchor.suffix: . Dreadful old case. Still he was a courteous old chap. Oldfashioned way he used to bow Molly off the platform. And the little mirror in his silk hat. The night Milly brought it in
